headline: Southern New Hampshire see off American International again
dek: Southern New Hampshire beat American International by three clear goals at home on Saturday, a wider margin than the single goal that settled their meeting there in September. Their one defeat in eighteen matches came at Adelphi in October.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-eight goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have conceded twelve goals in eighteen matches.

findings.label: derived

last_match.line: Southern New Hampshire have now won both of this season's meetings with American International.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
